Class BaleiaCatalogStore

java.lang.Object
io.baleia.trino.catalogstore.BaleiaCatalogStore
All Implemented Interfaces:
io.trino.spi.catalog.CatalogStore
public class BaleiaCatalogStore extends Object implements io.trino.spi.catalog.CatalogStore
Trino CatalogStore implementation backed by Baleia's PostgreSQL.

This is the core of the plugin. It implements the four SPI methods that Trino calls to manage catalogs:

  • getCatalogs() — boot path: loads all enabled rows, eagerly resolves secrets, and returns CatalogStore.StoredCatalog instances.
  • createCatalogProperties(CatalogName, ConnectorName, Map) — DDL path: resolves secrets in the user-supplied properties and computes a deterministic SHA-256 version.
  • addOrReplaceCatalog(CatalogProperties) — persists the catalog row via UPSERT.
  • removeCatalog(CatalogName) — soft-deletes the catalog (sets enabled=false).

The plugin does not poll. Runtime catalog propagation is the backend's responsibility via CREATE CATALOG DDL.

Error handling follows a two-tier model:

  • Connection-level failures (TrinoException) fail the boot.
  • Row-level failures (bad JSON, dangling secret reference) log, mark sync_status='error', and skip the row.

  • Method Details

    • getCatalogs

      public Collection<io.trino.spi.catalog.CatalogStore.StoredCatalog> getCatalogs()
      Loads all enabled catalogs from the database, resolves secrets, and returns them as CatalogStore.StoredCatalog instances.

      Called once at coordinator boot. Each row is processed independently: a bad row is logged, marked sync_status='error', and skipped. A total database failure retries with exponential backoff, then fails the boot.

      Specified by:
      getCatalogs in interface io.trino.spi.catalog.CatalogStore
      Returns:
      an unmodifiable collection of catalogs ready for Trino to load

    • createCatalogProperties

      public io.trino.spi.catalog.CatalogProperties createCatalogProperties(io.trino.spi.catalog.CatalogName catalogName, io.trino.spi.connector.ConnectorName connectorName, Map<String,String> properties)
      Resolves secrets in the user-supplied properties and computes a deterministic CatalogVersion (SHA-256).

      Called by Trino during CREATE CATALOG. The returned CatalogProperties carries the resolved values and the computed version — the caller will later pass it to addOrReplaceCatalog(CatalogProperties).

      Specified by:
      createCatalogProperties in interface io.trino.spi.catalog.CatalogStore
      Parameters:
      catalogName - the catalog name from the DDL statement
      connectorName - the connector type (e.g. "iceberg", "tpch")
      properties - raw properties from the DDL, may contain placeholders
      Returns:
      resolved properties with a deterministic version hash
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if a placeholder cannot be resolved
